title: Form view thank-you title and message have no translation key, so a public form's confirmation stays in the authoring language
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27398 (rows 2–3) said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread read the code on current `main` (report 6517203519, `out_of_scope_findings`). Row 2 is taken in PR #28003.
Reach: any public form read in another language. The heading and field labels are translated, but the thank-you panel is not (#27398 row 3).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec`.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "form submitBehavior thank-you message translation or record number interpolation public form" → #27417 and #7441, both closed and about other gaps.

## Observed
A form view's `submitBehavior` thank-you member carries `title` and `message` as plain strings. The bundle's `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW` entry (`TranslationItemSchema`, strict) declares `label`, `description`, `title`, `emptyState` and `bulkActions`, with no `submitBehavior` copy. `translateView` overlays only `bulkActionDefs`, `sections` and `title`.

## Wanted
Declare the thank-you `title` and `message` on the `_views` entry and overlay them in `translateView` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`), with the translation lint/coverage that reads `_views`. No ui change is needed: the public door `GET /api/v1/forms/SLUG` already serves the translated view config under `Accept-Language`, and the console form page reads `form.submitBehavior` from it.

Dedupe words: submitBehavior translation, thank-you title translate, _views submitBehavior, public form confirmation locale.

Related: #27398 (row 3).
